entities.name: Lucius Sestius Albanianus Quirinalis

entities.summary: Lucius Sestius Albanianus Quirinalis was an aristocrat of the late Roman Republic. Although having Republican tendencies, Augustus appointed him suffect consul in 23 BC to fill his role.
